messages:
Clare (People Ops): quick check — we have a couple of teams asking to swap midcycle calibration slots this week. who can cover the 11:30 PT canary calibration on Thurs?
Miguel (Eng Manager): I can take it if it stays 11:30-12:15. reassign the calendar invite to me.
Jess (Manager): Heads up I need to move my 11:30 to 14:00 — conflict with leadership sync. anyone else?
Rory (SWE): I can cover Thurs 11:30 but only if we keep it remote (no breakout room).
Laura (IC): tagging @Miguel — I also have a drop-in about form clarification at 11:45, might join the first half.
Clare (People Ops): thanks — Miguel, can you confirm on the invite? I'll update the public slot list. If we do the swap, please note the new owner needs to bring the calibration rubric PDF (latest).
Miguel (Eng Manager): confirmed, will drive. I have the rubric PDF saved as `calibration_rubric_v3.pdf` in the ops drive.
forms-bot: Reminder: performance form submissions will lock at 23:59 PT on 03/31. Late exceptions require a manager note and approval code.
Jess (Manager): ok moving my slot to 14:00, thx @Miguel for picking up 11:30. Clare — quick Q: is there a fallback for managers who can't make either slot?
Clare (People Ops): yes — we have two RTT slots on Friday (09:00 PT and 16:00 PT) reserved for manager fallbacks. If those don't work, file an exception via the form link below and cc me.
Aaron (Recruiting): small ops note — hiring folks will be paused from review notifications during calibration hours to avoid inbox noise. Should we post a banner in #general?
Clare (People Ops): good call — I'll post a brief banner and a pinned comment in the review tracker. message will say: "Calibration in progress Thu 11:30-12:15 PT; expect delays responding to review threads."
Rory (SWE): also, a quick forms glitch — when managers upload attachments the preview sometimes 404s. filed ticket #PR-438.
forms-bot: Ticket PR-438 created: "form attachment preview 404 on upload". Assigned to eng-forms. Priority medium.
Clare (People Ops): noted. if that blocks someone from submitting evidence, we can accept email attachments to people-ops@redwood (subject: REVIEW-EVIDENCE + employee name) until the ticket is resolved.
Jess (Manager): will share that fallback with my team. one more: are we still doing the optional rubric walkthrough for new managers on Wed?
Clare (People Ops): yes — Wed 10:00 PT is the walkthrough (30m). It's optional but recommended for first-time calibrators. I'll drop the Zoom link and the short checklist in the tracker.
Miguel (Eng Manager): small ask — can Clare add the expected timebox per calibration case (3-5 min) to the invite so folks can plan?
Clare (People Ops): will do. adding to the invite now.
Laura (IC): thanks — and FYI I might need to use the late-exception flow for a contractor review, will DM for the approval code.
Clare (People Ops): copy that, Laura. DM welcome.
deploy-bot: Deploy to staging succeeded (service: review-forms, sha: a1b2c3d).
Clare (People Ops): final ops checklist for the swap: 1) reassign invites 2) update public slot doc 3) post banner 4) confirm rubric availability 5) fallback email for attachments. I'm running through those now, ping me if anything falls through. :thumbsup:
Miguel (Eng Manager): all set from my side. I'll bring an example case to calibrate on.
Jess (Manager): thanks everyone. I'll update my team.
Clare (People Ops): closing loop here — calendar updated, banner posted, fallback instructions added to the tracker. if any manager still needs a slot swap, ping me before EOD.
